Title: Mushkin Helix-L M.2 NVMe SSD Review: NVMe on a Budget | Tom's Hardware
URL: https://www.tomshardware.com/reviews/mushkin-helix-l-nvme-ssd
Published: 2019-12-08T13:00:58.000Z
Author: Reviews By Sean Webster
Highlights:
Mushkin’s Helix-L is an entry-level SSD through and through. It’s pretty cheap, comes with a 3-year warranty, and it features a DRAMless controller architecture. Even so, it can still deliver a more-than-acceptable level of performance for gamers and mainstream users alike.

Mushkin’s Helix-L is marketed toward budget-conscious gamers with its DNA theme and pricing -- the 1TB model sells for just $107. It's powered by Silicon Motion’s SM2263XT PCIe 3.0 x4 NVMe SSD controller, and our sample features Micron’s 64L TLC NAND flash. This combo lacks DRAM, but resourcefully utilizes Host Memory Buffer, a feature of the NVMe protocol to aid performance instead.

Title: Mushkin Has Announced the Large Capacity Mushkin Helix-L SSD - MiniTool
URL: https://www.minitool.com/news/mushkin-helix-l-ssd.html
Published: 2019-05-23T06:10:09.000Z
Author: Tina
Highlights:
Mushkin has announced a series of new solid-state drives and they are the Mushkin Helix-L SSDs. This Mushkin Helix-L SSD delivers fast speed and we will show some other specifications of this Mushkin SSD in this post.

...

Nowadays, some users, especially for a gamer, always like to look for some NVMe SSDs since they can bring good performance than the traditional SATA SSDs and they cost less. So in order to satisfy the demands of users, Mushkin has announced a series of new solid-state drives and they are Mushkin Helix-L SSDs. Actually, Mushkin had announced that it would launch the Mushkin Helix-L SSD at CES 2019 and it has been released now.

...

First of all, let’s look at the capacity of these Mushkin Helix-L SSDs. They come in three different capacities which are 250GB, 512GB, and 1TB. It is featured with the Silicon Motion SM2263XT controller and M.2 2280 form factor.

In addition, the interface of this Mushkin Helix-L SSD is the PCIe 3.0 x4 /NVMe interface.

At the same time, this Mushkin Helix-L NVMe SSD also delivers fast transfer speed. For the 250GB model of this Mushkin Helix-L NVMe SSD, its sequential read and write speed can reach up to 2010MB/s and 1250MB/s. For the 512GB model of this Mushkin Helix-L SSDM, its sequential read and write speed can reach up to 2105MB/s and 1670MB/s. As for the 1TB, its sequential read and write speed can reach up to 2110MB/s and 1700MB/s.
